market_source: OKX official API V5 public REST
cycle: 1h UTC confirmed closed candles only; original 1h/4h/1d research context frozen
permission_rule: Require PROSPECTIVE, COMPLETED, AVAILABLE, valid data/plan, F1 pool and queued status, root and original_result allow_new_risk both true; otherwise archive/exclude. F2 never grants permissions.
known_f1_incompatibility: Current F1 PerpetualResearchResult fixes allow_new_risk=False. No current canonical candidate can pass F2 strict permission. No schema change or bypass in F2.

collection.scope: Observation delivery label only, NOT TTL extension or strategy change
collection.backfill: Actual acquisition time retained; any backfilled prefix suppresses F3 export
collection.gaps: Pause without committing incomplete coverage; retry only missing uncommitted interval
collection.expiry: Irreversible calendar expiry; unresolved history tagged UNKNOWN_UNOBSERVED, never proof of untriggered plan

event_commit: Per-registration nonblocking process lock; immutable old event objects in an atomic chain file; only committed observations count as watermark
namespace: Production and FIXTURE physically separated; fixture transitions cannot export F3 conditions
http_budget: Each inherited public GET has at most 3 HTTP attempts; scan CLI supervisor enforces hard wall deadline; direct Python scan API is cooperative only
f3: Condition confirmation only; no fills or settlement. Preserve original next_tradable_ms and actual decision_available_ms. Never backdate a fill to an already passed open.
scheduling: Single scan + external Windows Task Scheduler or cron; no persistent service installed or started
